data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a strengthening of prior year reserves by $70.644 million in 2024. This adverse development was influenced by specific prior year events, including further deterioration on the 2019 Ethiopian loss in the aviation market and ongoing uncertainties related to the Russia/Ukraine Conflict from 2022.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure from the Technical Provisions note ($70.644m strengthening) is used as the primary source. This differs from the sum of movements calculated from the gross claims development triangle ($41.434m strengthening). The note is considered more comprehensive. The 2022 year of account closed with a profit of $18.7m (page 5), which might seem contradictory to a strengthening of prior year reserves. However, the closed year result includes investment return and expenses, not just claims reserve movements.
